target.statement: ICG-based evaluation detects 16/25 injected state-related defects (64.0% detection rate), compared with 8/25 under WG-broad and 1/25 under WG-strict.
target.dataset: 25 injected state-related defects on GT-validated WebRISE pages

compute.basis: Even the smallest headline meta-evaluation requires the unpublished WebRISE benchmark, GT-validated pages, ICG contracts, browser agent, and DOM/VLM judges; 25 defect runs would be CPU/API-bound but no public harness or data is linked.

blockers: No public code or data release for the WebRISE benchmark or ICG evaluator
Requires the paper's MLLM browser agent and VLM/DOM judges, typically closed proprietary APIs
Defect-injection target depends on GT-validated WebRISE pages and ICG contracts that are not provided
Full benchmark contains 442 tasks, 5 modalities, 5,495 transitions and 12,441 assertions, so even re-running the meta-evaluation needs substantial unpublished infrastructure
title: WebRISE: Requirement-Induced State Evaluation for MLLM-Generated Web Artifacts
